rules.statement: A prescriptive servitude of way must be precise and definite, relating to a defined track, and not consisting of proof of mere straying across an open land at any point which is at the moment most convenient.
rules.supporting_quote: The evidence to establish a prescriptive servitude of way must be precise and definite. It must relate to a defined track, and must not consist of proof of mere straying across an open land at any point which is at the moment most convenient.
